summary.text: Amy Gray is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree from Oakland University and has worked in accounting; in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Amy Gray said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Macomb for more than 20 years, is the daughter of a career law enforcement officer, and raised two children there who graduated from Chippewa Valley Schools.
She said she volunteers with the Humane Society of Macomb.

Gray listed three campaign messages in the survey: keeping decisions about residential and business development under local control, easing the tax burden on small businesses, and being accountable and transparent to District 60 residents.
